Entities

In the package workflow, entities are the symbols and constants that appear in a problem definition.

Parameters and variables

  • Parameters are registered with nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.add_parameter().

  • Variables are registered with nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.add_variable().

  • Access is expression-based, for example x.x1 or y.y2.

Constants

Constants can be introduced manually with:

  • nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.matrix()

  • nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.vector()

  • nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.tensor()

or loaded in bulk with nlpoptnet.api.NLPOptNet.extract().
